user.title: Connect Zigbee2MQTT
user.description: Installation only connects to the existing catalog. Circuits and groups are added afterwards from Configure. The report extension is optional here and required for active pilot testing. These timings are shared by every circuit. No device commands are sent.

choose.title: Configure
choose.description: Add, edit and remove circuits or groups. Saving reloads the integration without replaying an old ON.

group_readiness.title: Group readiness
group_readiness.description: After the barrier limit, individual mode releases ready circuits and late members follow when verified reports arrive. Wait-for-all mode waits without a final deadline and sends one group command; a missing report holds the group. OFF, disconnection and reload cancel the wait. Saving reloads the integration without replaying ON.

data.group_barrier_timeout_ms: Shared-start limit before releasing circuits (ms, individual mode)

add_circuit.title: Add circuit
add_circuit.description: Name the virtual light and select one controller with its power channel. This does not add the circuit to a group. Saving reloads the integration. Control turns on again when the catalog is back and does not replay an old ON.

create_group.title: Create group
create_group.description: Name the group and select which added circuits belong to it. A name such as Salon creates the Zigbee2MQTT group and light entity Salon_orchestrator. A circuit already in another group is not listed. Saving reloads the integration. Control turns on again when the catalog is back and does not replay an old ON.

circuit_details.title: Edit circuit
circuit_details.description: Change the name, controller and power channel. For a grouped circuit, the Z2M membership is reconciled before saving. Power the old and new controllers yourself; the integration never turns them on automatically.

group_details.title: Edit group
group_details.description: Changing membership requires powered controllers. If interrupted, check the group status before retrying.

recover_group.title: Recover group operation
recover_group.description:
An operation for {group} was interrupted. Check the group in Zigbee2MQTT and ensure previous requests have finished. If the outcome is unknown, restart Zigbee2MQTT first. Recovery accepts an applied change or retries the missing step; it never turns power on.

{reason}

data.confirmed: I checked the group and Z2M has finished earlier requests

error.devices_missing: None of the configured circuits are in the Zigbee2MQTT catalog. Control stays off until one of them returns.
error.group_operation_failed: The change is unconfirmed. Check controller power and Z2M. If an operation is pending, open Configure → Recover group operation.

pause.name: Pause control
pause.description: Disable control and set every light's desired state to off without publishing.

resume.name: Resume control
resume.description: Restore the mode that was active before the pause. Previous commands are not replayed.

resync.name: Resync catalog
resync.description: Discard observations and re-read the Zigbee2MQTT catalog. Control must be enabled again afterwards.

options.wait_all: Wait for everyone: one group command
